label: Whatever has power for the actual contingents' joint absence is an actual root of the grounding
paraphrase: For every being y: if y has at w a power for the joint absence of the concrete beings contingent at w, then y is an actual root of the selected grounding relation G at w, in the profile on the frame's own world-relative existence (groundProfile F concrete G): concrete, existing at w, with no actual concrete G-ground at w. Universal over holders; asserts no holder's existence, no uniqueness, no God identification. G is a parameter, not identified with giving, causing, dependence for being or simple priority.
